blockMcqs.question: What two properties must a problem have for DP to apply?
options: Greedy choice and a sorted input
Overlapping sub-problems and optimal substructure
A balanced tree and constant memory
Independent sub-problems and a closed form
blockMcqs.explanation: Sub-problems must recur, and the best whole must be built from best parts.

blockMcqs.question: On a character match, the edit-distance recurrence does what?
options: Adds 1 to the diagonal neighbour
Takes the min of three neighbours plus 1
Copies the diagonal neighbour for free
Takes the max of up and left
blockMcqs.explanation: Matching characters need no edit, so the cost equals dp[i-1][j-1].

blockMcqs.question: How does a subsequence differ from a substring?
options: A subsequence must be contiguous
A subsequence allows gaps; a substring is contiguous
They are identical for strings
A substring allows reordering
blockMcqs.explanation: Gaps are allowed for subsequences, which changes the recurrence used.

blockMcqs.question: Why is knapsack called pseudo-polynomial?
options: It is O(n log n) on average only
O(n*W) is exponential in the bits of W
It needs exponential memory always
The recurrence has no closed form
blockMcqs.explanation: Cost grows with the value W, not its encoded length, so large W explodes.

blockMcqs.question: Iterating 1D 0/1 knapsack capacity low→high causes what?
options: A crash from an index error
It silently reuses each item, becoming unbounded
It doubles the time complexity
It loses the base cases
blockMcqs.explanation: An updated cell gets reread within the same pass, taking the item twice.

blockMcqs.question: When is bitmask DP the right tool?
options: When the array is already sorted
When n is at most about 20 and tracks a subset
When capacity W is very large
When the cost depends on a split point
blockMcqs.explanation: 2^n must stay near a million, so n beyond ~20 is infeasible.

blockMcqs.question: Which production tool relies on LCS / edit-distance DP?
options: A hash-based load balancer
git diff and code-review tools
A B-tree database index
A bloom filter cache
blockMcqs.explanation: Lines outside the common subsequence become the added and removed lines.

blockMcqs.question: Why does greedy fail for 0/1 knapsack?
options: It is too slow at O(n*W)
Best value-per-weight can leave dead capacity
It cannot handle negative weights
It always overfills the bag
blockMcqs.explanation: Greedy is optimal only for the fractional variant where items can be split.
